messages:
luca (Growth): Heads up — planning the microdrip for inbound leads from the launch blog + webinar. Need subject lines, segment rules, and cadence. thoughts? :thinking_face:
adele (Content): love it. short sequence? 3 touches feels right for a launch nurture.
jamal (Ops): Agree. We should gate by intent signals (downloaded benchmark, watched webinar > 50%). also dedupe against existing trialers.
sarah (Growth PM): Proposed cadence: send 0d (welcome), 2d (value + benchmark), 7d (invite to webinar/follow-up). keep each email ~50–90 words. windows: Tue–Thu mornings for outbound.
luca (Growth): segmentation draft — three buckets: 1) product-intent (downloaded benchmark or started trial), 2) researcher persona (opens docs, dev blog readers), 3) general inbound. priority routing: product-intent > researcher > general.
adele (Content): Subject line variants (A/B):
```
A: Welcome to Redwood — benchmarks, best practices, and a quick invite
B: How we cut inference cost by 3x — resources + invite
C: Quick wins for LLM inference at scale (webinar inside)
```
jamal (Ops): Routing logic pseudo-rule: `if lead.tags contains [benchmark_download, trial_started] then bucket=product-intent else if lead.source == 'dev-blog' then bucket=researcher else bucket=general`. Suppression: `do not send if suppression_list=true OR last_emailed < 14 days`.
marketing-bot: suppression_check: found 1,234 addresses flagged last 30d. click-rate baseline for similar sends: 3.1%.
luca (Growth): Thanks — can we tighten researcher -> only companies > 20 employees? want to keep webinar seats high-quality.
sarah (Growth PM): Yup — company_size >= 20 for researcher and product-intent. webinar CTA in email 2 and 3. calendar link: https://cal.com/redwood/webinar-spot (use UTM params).
adele (Content): I'll draft the three templates and drop in #docs for review. will include a 1-line personalized snippet for product-intent.
jamal (Ops): I'll wire the segment in SFMC/Hubspot and add dedupe rules. will run a dry send to the QA list on Mon.
luca (Growth): timeline: draft by EOD Fri, QA Mon, send window Tue. anyone object?
adele (Content): all good from me. :thumbsup:
sarah (Growth PM): good to go.
jamal (Ops): queued. will post results after QA.
luca (Growth): perfect — thanks team. I’ll pull the send checklist and share after QA. :rocket:
